description: This script defines a series of tests related to subject preservation when creating and applying patches using git format-patch and git am. It sets up baseline commits, creates patches with various subjects (short, long, multiline), and verifies that subjects are preserved or unwrapped as expected during patch application.

methods.name: make_patches
methods.description: Creates patches with specified subject type (short, long, multiline) and subject content, involving resets and commits in git.

methods.name: check_subject
methods.description: Checks that a specific patch subject has been preserved after applying the patch with git am.
